record_title: Boundary-stress directional derivatives and a metric kink criterion for isoperimetric uniqueness
limitations: The result is restricted to trace-free, volume-form-preserving metric directions; it is first-order only and does not establish Frechet differentiability, a second-order formula, or quantitative convergence rates for perturbed minimizers. The motivating preprint is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
